request: Owner, 13 Nov (screenshot of the guides band): «я бы хотел, чтобы иконки стали более такими реалистичными, потому что сейчас ну, нормально, но чуть-чуть… чуточку реалистичнее было бы хорошо».
model: gpt_image_2_6 (Higgsfield), quality high, 1k, transparent background, 4:3, the 9 Nov object as the image reference; one generation per object
promptTemplate: Edit the reference image: re-render this exact object as a realistic premium studio product photograph. Keep the same object and every part of it ([concept]), the same arrangement, the same three-quarter view from slightly above, the same framing and proportions, and the same warm palette of cream, sand, terracotta red, deep sage green and brushed brass. Make it noticeably more realistic than the reference: true-to-life materials and fine surface detail ([material cues per object]), natural soft studio light from the upper left, physically accurate soft shadows and a small soft contact shadow directly under the object. Keep it clean and only slightly idealized: no dust, scratches or clutter. Fully transparent background with crisp clean silhouette edges: no glow, no halo, no white rim, no backdrop or floor. No text, letters, numbers, logos, emblems, flags, people or hands.
processing: Trimmed, fitted inside 468×(H−12) and centred in the exact old 480×H frames, so no layout moves; WebP q84/alpha92 at 480 and 240. folder-quiet-240 is the new folder at 30% saturation, as before. Reviewed at full size on #2A2420 and #FFFDF9 against the 9 Nov set: same objects, view and palette; materials now read as real (leather grain and stitching, milled coin edges, wood grain, paper fibres, uneven ink); no text, numerals, currency symbols, crests, flags or people.
